your_book:
Wednesday was a broad retreat for Jaleel's book, which slipped roughly 0.7% on the session. The damage was spread across the largest positions: NVIDIA fell 1.5% despite a chip-sector headline that cited falling yields and Intel/SK Hynix manufacturing talks as tailwinds — the stock's own export-control and AI-capex-doubt overhang clearly outweighed the sector lift. AstraZeneca was the session's hardest hit top-ten name, dropping nearly 3%, and AZO shed 1.8% with no stock-specific catalyst visible beyond a broad analyst-forecast roundup that didn't feature it prominently. Zoetis (-1.7%) and Rocket Lab (-2.3%) also dragged. The few bright spots were small: On Holding gained 2.6%, ADBE added 1.0% as AI executives flagged potential growth slowdowns that briefly cooled disruption fears, and Danaher edged up 0.2%.

The thesis-versus-price divergence that deserves the most scrutiny is Lululemon. It carries a -20% unrealized loss, the book's deepest, a guidance cut confirmed in June with Americas comps running -5% for five straight quarters, and today it showed up in a "whale alerts" scan — large-money activity in a deteriorating fundamental story warrants skepticism, not comfort. BSX and RKLB also sit in negative territory, -9% and -10.3% respectively, and BSX's guidance has been slashed with flat growth guided through Q3. RKLB draws an AVOID verdict with the book's lowest quality-at-reasonable-price score (38), yet holds a 7.2% weight — that combination remains an open question.

Watch AZN into the next catalyst window: at nearly 3% today and only a -0.7% total gain, the cushion is thin. The pharma drug-pricing policy overhang (MFN deals, tariffs) adds a cluster risk given Jaleel's meaningful exposure across AZN, GILD, NVS, NBIX, and VRTX. ABT's EPS guide trim is a yellow flag ahead of its October 13 report, though its 19.7% unrealized gain provides buffer.

attention.note: The lowest QARP score in the book (38) combined with an AVOID verdict and a top-ten weight is a direct contradiction of the capital-preservation mandate — the thesis-to-price gap here has no model support.

attention.note: Five consecutive quarters of negative Americas comps, gutted margins, a confirmed guidance cut, and now large-money activity flagged on the session — the position needs a clear go-forward case or a sizing decision before the Dec 9 report.

attention.note: The STRONG BUY verdict has not been validated by price or management guidance; the October 28 earnings print is the next hard test of whether the thesis holds.
